lea:title: Nothing
lea:author: Idoru Toei
lea:description: A haunting meditation on the suffocating weight of silence and the fragility of connection. It explores the quiet desperation of a father watching his son fade into an emotional void, shadowed by the sterile performance of a life lived for an audience.
